Message:
🔔 DAY 143 (SATURDAY, MAY 23, 2026)
⛰️ ASCENDING MOUNT HOREB (AMH) – DAY 9 OF 40
📖 JOSHUA 1–2

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired)
The transition from Moses to Joshua represents the shift from the literal instruction of the law to the active combat of living truth. Swedenborg teaches that entering Canaan signifies the church being established in the human soul. Rahab’s scarlet cord represents the saving power of genuine good within the heart, protecting us even in the midst of spiritual warfare.

🙏 Prayer
Lord, make me strong and courageous as I step into this new territory of faith. Let Your presence walk with me, and let the truth guide every boundary I cross today. Amen.

🔔 DAY 144 (SUNDAY, MAY 24, 2026)
⛰️ ASCENDING MOUNT HOREB (AMH) – DAY 10 OF 40
📖 JOSHUA 3–4

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired)
The parting of the Jordan River represents introduction into the church and the initial removal of falsities that block our spiritual progress. Swedenborg notes that the twelve stones taken from the dry riverbed symbolize the foundational truths of the Word, which must be firmly established in our memory to remember the Lord's deliverance.

🙏 Prayer
Father, part every obstacle that stands between me and Your promises. Establish Your truths deep in my memory, that I may always declare Your marvelous works in my life. Amen.

🔔 DAY 145 (MONDAY, MAY 25, 2026)
⛰️ ASCENDING MOUNT HOREB (AMH) – DAY 11 OF 40
📖 JOSHUA 5–6

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired)
The collapse of the walls of Jericho represents the overthrow of deeply rooted evils and false principles. Swedenborg explains that shouting and blowing the trumpets symbolize the powerful proclamation of Divine Truth from a heart full of love. When the Word is proclaimed in true faith, the defensive walls of our ego fall.

🙏 Prayer
Lord, let the walls of pride, doubt, and limitation crumble before Your presence. Bring down every internal stronghold that resists Your holy spirit in my life. Amen.

🔔 DAY 146 (TUESDAY, MAY 26, 2026)
⛰️ ASCENDING MOUNT HOREB (AMH) – DAY 12 OF 40
📖 JOSHUA 7–8

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired)
Achan’s hidden sin and the initial defeat at Ai show how hidden selfishness disrupts our spiritual protection. Swedenborg teaches that spiritual victory is impossible while we secretly harbor or justify what is evil. True restoration and victory at Ai follow inner purification and complete transparency before the Lord.

🙏 Prayer
Search me, O God, and know my heart. Cleanse me from secret faults and help me live a life of complete integrity, so that Your power may rest upon me completely. Amen.

🔔 DAY 147 (WEDNESDAY, MAY 27, 2026)
⛰️ ASCENDING MOUNT HOREB (AMH) – DAY 13 OF 40
📖 JOSHUA 9–10

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired)
The deception of the Gibeonites warns against relying on mere natural appearances without seeking divine counsel. Swedenborg teaches that the sun standing still in Gibeon represents the constant, undiminished flow of Divine Love and Light provided by the Lord when His people are engaged in spiritual combat against negativity.

🙏 Prayer
Father, grant me spiritual discernment so I am not deceived by outward appearances. I thank You for Your unwavering light that shines upon my battles, giving me total victory. Amen.

🔔 DAY 148 (THURSDAY, MAY 28, 2026)
⛰️ ASCENDING MOUNT HOREB (AMH) – DAY 14 OF 40
📖 JOSHUA 11–12

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired)
The systematic conquest of the northern kings signifies the complete subjugation of diverse spiritual errors. Swedenborg explains that hamstrings on the enemy's horses represent disabling the destructive power of a perverted natural understanding. The Lord gives total rest once our lower nature is brought into subjection.

🙏 Prayer
Lord, disable every thought pattern and force that seeks to pull me away from Your order. Subdue every inner enemy and bring my mind into perfect alignment with Your peace. Amen.

🔔 DAY 149 (FRIDAY, MAY 29, 2026)
⛰️ ASCENDING MOUNT HOREB (AMH) – DAY 15 OF 40
📖 JOSHUA 13–14

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired)
Caleb’s request for the mountain country at an advanced age shows that spiritual strength does not fade with time. Swedenborg teaches that inheriting specific lands corresponds to the unique placement of truths within our spiritual economy. Wholeness requires us to claim every spiritual gift the Lord has allotted to us.

🙏 Prayer
Father, give me the persistent faith of Caleb to claim my spiritual inheritance. Renew my strength daily during this fast, and let me possess the high places You have promised me. Amen.

🔔 DAY 150 (SATURDAY, MAY 30, 2026)
⛰️ ASCENDING MOUNT HOREB (AMH) – DAY 16 OF 40
📖 JOSHUA 15–17

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired)
The allotment of land to Judah, Ephraim, and Manasseh represents how different principles of love and faith are organized within the human mind. Swedenborg notes that when daughters request inheritances, it signifies that pure affections for truth have a legitimate and honored place in the Lord's kingdom.

🙏 Prayer
Lord, organize my mind according to Your heavenly design. Let my love for Your truth find its rightful place, bearing fruit that honors Your name. Amen.

🔔 DAY 151 (SUNDAY, MAY 31, 2026)
⛰️ ASCENDING MOUNT HOREB (AMH) – DAY 17 OF 40
📖 JOSHUA 18–20

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired)
The setting up of the Tabernacle at Shiloh and the establishment of the cities of refuge represent the centering of worship and divine mercy. Swedenborg explains that the cities of refuge symbolize the protection the Lord provides to those who make errors out of ignorance rather than malice, shielding them from spiritual condemnation.

🙏 Prayer
Father, be my sanctuary and my city of refuge. Protect my mind from the accusations of the adversary, and let Your mercy envelope me as I seek to walk uprightly. Amen.

🔔 DAY 152 (MONDAY, JUNE 1, 2026)
⛰️ ASCENDING MOUNT HOREB (AMH) – DAY 18 OF 40
📖 JOSHUA 21–22

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired)
The Levites receiving cities scattered among all the tribes shows that spiritual devotion must permeate every aspect of life. Swedenborg notes that the misunderstanding over the altar built by the eastern tribes teaches that true worship is internal unity of spirit, not merely external appearance or ritual conformity.

🙏 Prayer
Lord, let Your spirit saturate every department of my life. Keep me unified with my brethren in true love, looking beyond outward perceptions to the sincerity of the heart. Amen.

🔔 DAY 153 (TUESDAY, JUNE 2, 2026)
⛰️ ASCENDING MOUNT HOREB (AMH) – DAY 19 OF 40
📖 JOSHUA 23–24

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired)
Joshua’s final charge—"Choose this day whom you will serve"—sets the ultimate law of human free will. Swedenborg teaches that true faith can only be received and kept in freedom. When we declare, "As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord," we permanently bind our inner life to heaven.

🙏 Prayer
Father, with my whole heart and free will, I choose to serve You today and always. Let my household be a temple of Your presence, and let my life seal this covenant forever. Amen.

🔔 DAY 154 (WED, JUNE 3, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 20 OF 40
📖 Acts 1–2

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Jesus’ final instructions urge the disciples to wait for the Holy Spirit—a symbol of Divine Truth flowing into receptive hearts. The descent at Pentecost, with tongues of fire, signifies that the Lord’s spirit can fill all people who desire to love and understand truth. In the New Church, the outpouring of the Spirit marks the opening of our understanding to heavenly life and the power to witness to Divine Truth (Acts 2:1-4).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, as You once filled the disciples, fill me with Your Spirit today. Open my mind to Your wisdom and let the fire of Your love rest upon my heart. Let me serve and witness in Your name. Amen.

🔔 DAY 155 (THU, JUNE 4, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 21 OF 40
📖 Acts 3–4

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Peter heals a lame man, showing that the Lord still brings wholeness to broken places in our lives. “Silver and gold have I none, but such as I have, give I thee.” True healing flows from faith and charity—not material things, but the living power of the Lord within us. When challenged, the apostles’ courage is from the Spirit, teaching us that heavenly power is granted when we rely on the Lord and speak in truth (Acts 3:6, 4:8).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, let me share what I receive from You—spiritual wholeness, healing, and courage. Make my words and actions a testimony to Your living presence. Amen.

🔔 DAY 156 (FRI, JUNE 5, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 22 OF 40
📖 Acts 5–6

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
The story of Ananias and Sapphira is a warning about hypocrisy in spiritual life; external profession without internal truth suffocates the soul. The apostles continue to work miracles, symbolizing how true faith, joined with charity, brings transformation. The ordination of deacons shows that the Church thrives when all serve according to their spiritual gifts (Acts 5:1-10, 6:3).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, purify my intentions. Let my service and gifts be fully consecrated to You. Breathe into me both truth and love, that my life may honor You in all things. Amen.

🔔 DAY 157 (SAT, JUNE 6, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 23 OF 40
📖 Acts 7

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Stephen’s speech traces the faith journey from Abraham to Christ, showing history as a living parable. His martyrdom reflects the resistance of the ego (the “old man”) to Divine Truth. Yet as Stephen beholds the heavens opened, we learn that those who remain in faith, even under trial, receive inward sight of heavenly realities (Acts 7:55-56).

🙏 Prayer:
Heavenly Father, help me to see above earthly trials to Your eternal kingdom. Strengthen me to bear witness with courage and forgive, as Stephen did, from a spirit of love. Amen.

🔔 DAY 158 (SUN, JUNE 7, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 24 OF 40
📖 Acts 8–9

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
The conversion of Saul reveals how Divine Truth, even when resisted, can transform the hardest heart. Philip’s guidance of the Ethiopian shows that everyone seeking truth can find it when led by the Lord. The true miracle is not just healing or signs, but the change of our inner vision—spiritual rebirth (Acts 9:3-18).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, remove my spiritual blindness and give me sight to know You. May my life, like Paul’s, be transformed by Your call and Your light within me. Amen.

🔔 DAY 159 (MON, JUNE 8, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 25 OF 40
📖 Acts 10

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Peter’s vision of the clean and unclean animals teaches that the Lord’s love and truth are offered to everyone—no one is spiritually unclean who receives the Lord in heart and life. The true Church is universal, formed of all who accept the influx of Divine life (Acts 10:34-35).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, expand my heart to embrace all Your children. Help me see beyond externals to the living spirit within, and let Your love break down every barrier. Amen.

🔔 DAY 160 (TUE, JUNE 9, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 26 OF 40
📖 Acts 11–12

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Peter explains that the Holy Spirit is given to all who turn to God, affirming again the inclusivity of Divine mercy. The Church faces persecution, but miracles—like Peter’s deliverance—show that the Lord’s providence is still at work, opening doors in every prison (Acts 12:5-7).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, in times of trial and uncertainty, remind me that You open ways where none seem possible. Strengthen my faith and help me trust Your unseen hand. Amen.

🔔 DAY 161 (WED, JUNE 10, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 27 OF 40
📖 Acts 13

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Paul’s first missionary journey begins, showing that truth proceeds from the Lord and travels far to reach open minds and hearts. Spiritual journeys are journeys of enlightenment—receiving, then spreading, the Word (Acts 13:2-3).

🙏 Prayer:
Use me, Lord, as Your messenger wherever You lead. Let my words reflect Your truth and my life Your love, so that others may be touched by You through me. Amen.

🔔 DAY 162 (THU, JUNE 11, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 28 OF 40
📖 Acts 14–15

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
The apostles face both acceptance and resistance. The council at Jerusalem resolves disputes, showing that unity in the Church comes when love is joined with truth. The Church grows not when we impose burdens, but when we encourage faith expressing itself through love (Acts 15:28-29).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, help me value harmony and peace. Let me live according to Your Spirit—holding fast to truth and abounding in love—so that my life may be a blessing to others. Amen.

🔔 DAY 163 (FRI, JUNE 12, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 29 OF 40
📖 Acts 16–17

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Paul and Silas sing in prison; the jailer is converted. Joy and faith are born not from circumstances, but from the Lord’s presence within. The noble Bereans remind us to receive the Word eagerly and search the Scriptures daily (Acts 16:25-34, 17:11).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, when darkness surrounds me, let Your light and joy rise within. Make my heart steadfast in searching Your Word, trusting Your presence in every trial. Amen.

🔔 DAY 164 (SAT, JUNE 13, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 30 OF 40
📖 Acts 18–19

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
The teaching and healing in Corinth and Ephesus reveal that whenever Divine Truth is received, spiritual communities grow. Opposition may arise, but the genuine work of the Spirit brings transformation. True worshipers receive and act from the Lord’s love (Acts 18:9-10, 19:18-20).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, establish Your Church within my heart. Let me be open to instruction and bold in sharing Your love and truth wherever I go. Amen.

🔔 DAY 165 (SUN, JUNE 14, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 31 OF 40
📖 Acts 20–21

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Paul’s farewell to the Ephesians reminds us that ministry is service, and that each of us is a shepherd, watching over our spiritual flock. There will be trials, but the Lord’s grace is sufficient for every need (Acts 20:24, 32).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, keep me faithful in the care of all You entrust to me. Let Your grace and Word sustain me, and guide my steps in love. Amen.

🔔 DAY 166 (MON, JUNE 15, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 32 OF 40
📖 Acts 22–23

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Paul’s testimony before the people and council shows that every spiritual journey involves witness and the courage to stand for what is right. Divine Providence continues to lead and protect all who live in sincerity and faith (Acts 23:11).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, empower me to stand for Your truth with humility and strength. Let my witness spring from love for You and for all people. Amen.

🔔 DAY 167 (TUE, JUNE 16, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 33 OF 40
📖 Acts 24–25

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Paul’s trials before governors teach us to be patient and steadfast amid misunderstandings and delay. The Lord’s timing is purposeful, allowing our faith to deepen and our trust to be perfected (Acts 24:16).

🙏 Prayer:
Father, in seasons of waiting or adversity, help me rest in Your Providence. Strengthen my patience and let my hope in You remain unshaken. Amen.

🔔 DAY 168 (WED, JUNE 17, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 34 OF 40
📖 Acts 26–28

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Paul bears witness to kings and is finally delivered to Rome, showing that the Lord can use all circumstances to spread the Gospel. The journey is never wasted when entrusted to Divine leading; every trial is turned into good and used for spiritual rebirth and sharing the Lord’s kingdom (Acts 28:30-31).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, use my journey—all my trials and blessings—for Your heavenly purposes. Make me ever willing to serve, testify, and trust in Your unfailing guidance. Amen.
